bold_leap: The transferable conversion object is a continuous azimuthal q=1 front sheet whose radius field remains beam-local, ordered, and unbiased across natural and robust H I visibility weighting.
mechanism: Visibility weighting perturbs the sampled molecular-to-atomic ratio q inside one synthesized support element, but a persistent physical conversion isocontour preserves the linearly interpolated first-crossing radius r_star(phi) without multi-beam displacement, destroyed azimuthal order, or coherent signed radial drift.

domain_native_variables.I_CO21: HERACLES CO(2-1) integrated brightness, K km s^-1
domain_native_variables.sigma_I_CO21: HERACLES integrated-brightness uncertainty, K km s^-1
domain_native_variables.I_HI_NA: THINGS natural-weighted H I integrated brightness, K km s^-1
domain_native_variables.I_HI_RO: THINGS robust-weighted H I integrated brightness, K km s^-1
domain_native_variables.Sigma_mol_He: face-on molecular-plus-helium surface density, solar masses pc^-2
domain_native_variables.Sigma_HI_He: face-on atomic-plus-helium surface density, solar masses pc^-2
domain_native_variables.q_j: Sigma_mol_He/Sigma_HI_He in common-beam ring j, dimensionless
domain_native_variables.r_left_kpc: center radius of the first eligible q>1 ring
domain_native_variables.r_right_kpc: center radius of its adjacent eligible q<1 ring
domain_native_variables.rho_front: Spearman correlation of the eight natural and robust r_star fields

geometry.authority: Walter et al. 2008 THINGS table 1 local frozen extraction

solver_conventions.common_beam_operator: Convert each THINGS map from Jy beam^-1 m s^-1 to K km s^-1 at its own clean beam, then normalized-convolve CO, CO uncertainty, and both H I maps to the frozen circular beam.
solver_conventions.co_uncertainty: Propagate independent CO variance with the squared convolution kernel and identical finite-support normalization.
solver_conventions.sectors: eight fixed deprojected 45-degree sectors phi=[0,45),...,[315,360), measured from the frozen position angle
solver_conventions.eligibility: finite positive convolved CO with annular mean SNR at least 3 and finite positive normalized-convolved H I brightness
solver_conventions.first_crossing: Use the smallest ring index j with four consecutive eligible rows ending at j, q[j-1]>1, q[j]<1, and negative adjacent q slope; if absent, permit only one eligible strict crossing ending at ring 2 or 3; otherwise no valid V150 interpolation.
solver_conventions.interpolation: Linear interpolation in q between the two frozen first-pair ring centers.
solver_conventions.no_retuning: No target, source, center, geometry, beam, annulus, sector, conversion, eligibility, q threshold, pair, smoothing, interpolation, deletion, or tolerance may change after this protocol hash.

risky_predictions: P150-P1: all eight sectors have valid natural and robust first-pair q=1 interpolations.
P150-P2: maximum absolute natural-versus-robust normalized front-radius shift is at most one common-beam FWHM.
P150-P3: at least six of eight sectors and the median absolute shift are within 0.25 common-beam FWHM.
P150-P4: natural-versus-robust front-radius Spearman rho is at least 0.90 and absolute median signed shift is at most 0.15 beam.
orthodox_competitor: Weighting-dependent masking, line-of-sight structure, shared visibility noise, and CO support need not preserve a continuous front sheet and may yield missing crossings, multi-beam shifts, lost ordering, or coherent signed bias.
fresh_kill_condition: Kill exact V150 if any sector lacks a valid first-pair interpolation, maximum absolute shift exceeds 1.0 beam, fewer than six sectors or the median fail the 0.25-beam concentration gate, Spearman rho is below 0.90, or absolute median signed shift exceeds 0.15 beam. No tolerance, pair, sector, source, or geometry retune after outcome access.
known_values_boundary: Earlier NGC6946 lanes opened direct Leroy radial gas-source values, radial sign/order statistics, and other galaxy-level observables. No common-beam HERACLES-plus-THINGS natural/robust eight-sector V150 profiles or continuous front radii were computed or inspected before this protocol.
claim_boundary: Prospective only for the exact V150 continuous front-sheet observable. Conservative DTE cross-weighting test using shared THINGS visibilities; not galaxy-blind, not an independent telescope-family replication, and no population, causal-mechanism, gravity, dark-sector, TCG, TEC, SPEC, promotion, paper, send, contact, or discovery claim.
